pieces.Text: You currently are or formerly were a professional-level athlete with highly specialized physical skills. You might be a member of your region's sports team, chosen for your exceptional strength or finesse, or maybe you competed in individual events requiring exemplary endurance. Your prowess may have already led you to travel extensively for competitions, or you might still be an up-and-coming star. Either way, your impressive physical capabilities enable you to make a living as a professional competitor.
